description: This PHP source file defines the SaveEmailSubscriptionController class within the OrangeHRM framework. The class extends AbstractVueController and manages the pre-render logic for editing email subscriptions, specifically by setting up a Vue component with a subscription ID if provided in the request.

classes.name: SaveEmailSubscriptionController
classes.description: Controller for handling the pre-render setup of email subscription editing, initializing Vue component with subscription ID if available.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by adding the subscription ID property if present in the request.
